review:
LootLines in ancient Rome. Tribute symbols on a winning line form a LootLine, and their values combine left to right before being multiplied by your bet: adders give 1x to 10x, revealing ones 15x to 500x, and multiplying ones double to quintuple the running total.

Multipliers act on whatever's built up before them, so where they sit on the line really matters – a row of small adders followed by an x5 can turn into something decent. Takes a few spins to learn. 15,000x max.
